_instructions: End-to-end feature ledger for Sift (the actual app lives in ./sift). Each session: pick ONE feature with passes:false, implement it, then run its steps as a human would (npm run dev from ./sift, or npm test for unit-backed ones) and verify before marking passes:true. JSON is used deliberately so it isn't casually rewritten.
_rules: It is unacceptable to delete or weaken tests, or to flip passes:true, just to make the suite look green — this hides missing or broken functionality.
Only set passes:true after running the listed steps and confirming the result (browser for UI, vitest for lib).
Add new features here as the app grows; aim toward exhaustive coverage, not a token list.

_meta.stack: React 18 + Vite + Vitest, dnd-kit, Capacitor local-notifications

features.description: High-confidence text auto-files into the best tray with no prompt
steps: Type text strongly matching one tray's words
Verify item appears in that tray with no toast/slip

features.description: Medium-confidence text files but shows an undo toast
steps: Verify toast 'filed under X · N% sure' with Undo

features.description: Low-confidence text opens the PendingSlip to create or choose a tray
steps: Verify tray created and item filed in it

features.description: PendingSlip can file the item under an existing tray instead of creating one
steps: Verify item filed there and slip dismissed

features.description: A card can be dragged into another tray, sets refiled flag, and persists after reload
steps: Verify it stayed in the new tray

features.description: Trays can be added, renamed, and deleted (with item reassignment + confirm)
steps: Verify items moved to first tray and tray removed

features.description: The last remaining tray cannot be deleted
steps: Attempt to delete the last tray

features.description: An item can be marked done and undone
Completing a repeating item reschedules it to the next occurrence
steps: Create item with a due date and repeat
Verify toast 'done — next: ...' and new future due

features.description: EditSheet edits text/tray/due/remind and can delete the item
Capturing text with a concrete date arms a reminder and requests permission
steps: Type text containing a concrete date/time
Verify item has remind=true and permission is requested

features.description: Web fallback fires a Notification when a reminder is due (app open, permission granted)
steps: Verify a Sift notification fires and notifiedAt is set once

features.description: On native (Capacitor) scheduled notifications stay in sync with items
steps: Verify scheduled local notifications match current items

features.description: The search box filters visible items by text
Sort switches between newest and due
Theme button cycles auto/light/dark and follows system in auto
Trays render as one vertical column of collapsible sections (fold persists across reload); flat design with no drop shadows; item rows are single-line and readable
steps: Verify trays stack vertically (no column grid, no mobile swipe pager)
Collapse a tray via its caret
Drag an item onto another section
Verify it refiled and the move persists
Confirm no box-shadow anywhere (and on mobile width it is the same vertical list)

features.description: Data exports to JSON and re-imports (with normalize); bad files are rejected
Reset erases device data and restores demo seeds (after confirm)
steps: Verify demo trays/items restored and trace/pending/toast cleared

features.description: Items/trays/theme persist across reloads (device storage)
Refiling teaches the router — a corrected item's salient words shift future routing toward the chosen tray (write to per-tray words[], never the shared seed lexicons)
steps: Refile/correct an item into tray X
Capture new text similar to it
Verify it now routes to X

features.description: classifier/dates/store unit suites pass
steps: Verify classifier.test, dates.test, store.test all green
